note: San Francisco signal heads: the geometry of two published models (sources), licensed CC BY 4.0, modified as each row says (cut to one head, rescaled, re-framed, a backplate added, rebaked and weathered). The photographs the sources carry as lens and face textures are not used (the pedestrian ones are Flickr photographs under CC BY-NC 2.0, the others have no record of who took them): the lens and face images are drawn by the script. Built by the script below in Blender; frames: glTF Y up; signalHead origin at the middle lens centre, lenses toward +Z; pedHead origin at the face centre, face toward +Z.

signalHead.changes: one head of the set kept (its housing, visors, gaskets and wing nuts), scaled to the game lens pitch and moved to the game frame; a louvred backplate with a 2 in yellow border added (closed behind the housing); the flat materials replaced by a baked, weathered albedo and metallic-roughness atlas; the lenses re-mapped 0..1 across each lens and their photographs dropped (the drawn lens image in their place); the lenses' domes deepened and their faces turned out of the head (the source's face into it); the visors' and the lenses' rings rounded (each segment split, the new points on the circle); the tunnel visors cut away underneath

pedHead.changes: one hooded head of the pack kept (housing and face) and moved to the game frame; the flat housing material replaced by a baked, weathered albedo and metallic-roughness atlas; the face re-mapped 0..1 across it and its photographs dropped (the drawn face image, under an egg-crate lattice, in their place)
